key_insight: SACK prioritizes incoming samples by their semantic relationships to previously learned concepts to improve continual learning while reducing forgetting.
engineering_relevance: SACK could support sequential updates to engineering learning models, but the abstract does not demonstrate constitutive modeling or solid mechanics applications.
method: Dissect learned categorical knowledge into fine-grained concepts.
Compute relationships between previously learned and incoming concepts.
Use concept relationships to prioritize new samples within existing continual learning methods.
evidence_signal: Experiments across regularization, replay, and prompt-based methods in class- and task-incremental settings report improved accuracy, forgetting, calibration, and robustness, including under long-tail distributions.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify gains or the computational overhead of extracting concepts and ranking incoming samples.
paper_title: Sequentially Acquiring Concept Knowledge to Guide Continual Learning
